title: euphrasia odontites proles serotinus
intro: Euphrasia odontites proles serotinus, commonly known as late-spurred gentian, is a perennial plant species within the gentian family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant effects. The health benefits of Euphrasia odontites proles serotinus include its ability to soothe sore throats, reduce congestion, and ease respiratory discomfort. Its bioactive constituents include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting expectoration and alleviating respiratory inflammation.
